# Download Reads

```{bash}
wget -r \
--no-directories --no-parent \
-P ../../data/Haws-11 \
-A "*.fq.gz" \
https://gannet.fish.washington.edu/spartina/project-oyster-oa/Haws/trimmed-data-2/
```

```{bash}
cd ../../data/Haws-11
curl -O https://gannet.fish.washington.edu/seashell/bu-github/project-oyster-oa/data/Haws-10/GCF_963853765.1_xbMagGiga1.1_genomic.fa
```


# Genome Prep

```{bash}
# Directories and programs
bismark_dir=""
bowtie2_dir=""
genome_folder="../../data/Haws-11/"

${bismark_dir}bismark_genome_preparation \
--verbose \
--parallel 28 \
${genome_folder}
```


```{bash}
ls ../../data/Haws-11/*_R1_val_1_val_1.fq.gz | wc -l
```
